summary.headline: Impediment of the King
summary.text: Astrological rules for a king’s weakening, replacement, and subjugation of enemies, using the evil planet’s location, relation to the Sun, angularity, retrogradation, and direction. Chapter XV then begins instructions on impediments to the king according to the house occupied by the evil planet aspecting the lord of the year or the king’s significator.
